SUMMARY
Leveraging its strong vacuum heritage, Tineco is leading the evolution of cordless vacuums and small appliances by making everyday products smarter. Our passion for innovation drives us to create technology that helps people “live easy, enjoy life.” At Tineco USA, we are building a creative and diverse team of talented individuals who want to be part of this transformation. We believe our people are essential to our success, and those who embrace new challenges and the unknown will thrive here.

We are seeking a Demand Planner to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for all forecasting activities for assigned sales channels and products. The Demand Planner develops and maintains forecast models, integrating business insights and information from internal S ales, Product/GTM , F inance team, retailer replenishment analysts, and other key partners.

Role and Responsibilities

Possess strong knowledge of supply chain and logistics processes to provide informed recommendations to stakeholders and make sound planning-related decisions.
Navigate the dynamics of a sales-driven business by effectively balancing operational objectives with the need to support sales goals.
Take ownership of all planning activities for assigned sales channels and demonstrate the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Develop demand forecasts for assigned sales channels across multiple aggregation levels and time horizons
Analyze historical sales trends, identify key demand drivers, prepare forecasting data, and evaluate forecast accuracy.
Collaborate with Sales, Product/GTM, and Finance to incorporate current business insights into the demand forecast.
Closely work with sales and sales representative group members to understand the business and capture any updates which could impact planning related activities and decisions .
Collaborate with retailers through on-cadence CPFR meetings (virtual or in-person) to present planning team with any updates and address any questions from the retailers and potential risks or issues from a planning perspective .
Manage supply planning activities, including updating bi-weekly supply planning files, reviewing inventory levels and inbound shipments, and partnering with HQ counterparts to coordinate demand inputs to ensure alignment across the planning process and secure sufficient inventory to support the forecast.
Collaborate closely with the Operations team to monitor POs, inventory availability, transfers, and rework, ensuring forecasts are fully supported, and perform additional related activities as needed.
Communicate and collaborate with China-based HQ teams as needed.

Skills and Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in related field
Bilingual in English and Mandarin is a plus
2+ years prior Supply Chain- Demand planning experience required
Retail or eCommerce experience is required; industry experience in consumer electronics is a plus.
Wholesale experience is a plus
Technical knowledge in the CE industry is a plus
Intermediate experience with Microsoft Office Suite, especially spreadsheet modeling skills, including PivotTables, lookups, basic formulas, and data organization
Advanced experience with Power BI; experience with TrackVia is a plus
Adaptable to the fast-paced industry
Strong work ethic with high energy and initiative
Highly detail oriented and precise in work
Ability to multi-task and prioritize
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Organized and a Problem solver
Able to collaborate effectively within a team while also excelling as an independent contributor
Travel up to 10% within Canada and to the North American home office in Seattle, Washington. Travel may include visits to sales representative teams, retailers, retail events, and TUSA’s warehouse.

Reports to: Demand and Planning Manager

Benefits:

Medical, dental, and vision – 90% company paid for employee only plans, 80% company paid for dependent plans
401(k) plan with 50% company match up to 4% of salary
10 holidays
15 days PTO
10% bonus potential based on meeting annual KPIs
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
60% Company Paid Long Term Disability
$20,000 Company Paid Life & AD&D Insurance
Access to Health Advocacy – provides expert help in navigating the complex healthcare system, 24/7

Tineco Intelligent Inc. is seeking a strategic, results oriented Senior Sales Director, USA to lead sales strategy, revenue growth, and key retail partnerships across the United States. This role is responsible for driving sales performance, expanding retail and distribution partnerships, executing go-to-market strategies, and leading a high performing sales team.

As a key member of the sales leadership team, the Senior Sales Director will be expected to balance strategic leadership with hands on execution. This is a player-coach role requiring active involvement in managing key customer relationships, leading negotiations, developing account strategies, analyzing business performance, and partnering cross functionally to deliver results. Depending on business needs and the candidate's experience, this role may also support or assume responsibility for the Mexico market as the business continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and execute the U.S. sales and go-to-market strategy to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
Own the overall performance of the U.S. business, ensuring achievement of annual sales targets and key business metrics.
Personally lead and manage relationships with strategic retail partners, distributors, and key accounts, serving as the executive point of contact for the business.
Develop and execute annual business plans with key customers, including sales strategies, promotional initiatives, assortment planning, and joint business development activities.
Identify and pursue new business opportunities, sales channels, and strategic partnerships to accelerate growth.
Remain actively involved in account management, retailer meetings, business reviews, negotiations, and problem resolution, while providing leadership and direction to the sales team.
Lead, coach, and develop a high performing team by setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, and fostering accountability and professional growth.
Partner closely with Marketing, Operations, Finance, Supply Chain, and Product teams to successfully execute product launches, promotional campaigns, and business initiatives.
Own sales forecasting, demand planning inputs, budgeting, and business performance analysis, using data to identify opportunities and drive informed business decisions.
Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and customer insights to proactively adapt strategies and maintain a competitive advantage.
Drive operational improvements that enhance retailer service levels, sales execution, and overall customer experience.
Collaborate with leadership teams in both the United States and China to align regional execution with global business priorities.
Support the continued growth of the business in Mexico, with the opportunity to expand regional responsibilities based on business needs and organizational growth.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field required.
10+ years of progressive sales leadership experience within consumer electronics, home appliances, or consumer packaged goods (CPG).
Proven success managing large national retail accounts and executing sales strategies within the U.S. market.
Demonstrated ability to lead teams while remaining actively engaged in day-to-day business execution and customer management.
Strong knowledge of retail distribution channels, forecasting, account planning, and joint business development.
Experience working within a fast-paced, high growth organization where adaptability and a hands-on approach are essential.
Excellent communication, negotiation, analytical, and relationship building skills.
Experience supporting business development or retail partnerships in Mexico is a plus.
Spanish language proficiency is preferred but not required.
Ability to travel domestically up to 20%, with occasional international travel as business needs require.

.

Reports to: VP, Americas

Salary Range: $185,000-225,000

Benefits:

Medical, dental, and vision – up to 95% company paid for employee only plans, up to 80% company paid for dependent plans
401(k) plan with 50% company match on up to 4% of salary
10 holidays
15 days PTO
20 to 30% bonus potential based on meeting annual KPIs
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
60% Company Paid Long Term Disability
$20,000 Company Paid Life & AD&D Insurance
Access to Health Advocacy – provides expert help in navigating the complex healthcare system, 24/7
